OOS_protocol.data_window: to be fixed in the registration before any data is read
OOS_protocol.train_test_boundary: final holdout window never used for threshold selection

capacity_model.note: limited by the thinner of spot and perp depth; borrow for spot shorts not available to the owner

counterparty: leveraged perp traders paying a premium/discount; forced liquidations at extremes
drawdown_model: mark-to-market basis drawdown measured on synchronised prices
economic_mechanism: Counterparty: the leveraged directional trader who pays a premium to be long through the perp (or discount to be short) and the liquidation-driven flow at extremes. Persists while perp leverage demand outstrips arbitrage balance sheet; disappears as basis desks compete, and when basis widens further before converging (mark-to-market and margin risk on the hedge).
eligibility_rules: BTC and ETH only until a larger PIT universe exists
both legs tradable at the timestamp
entry: enter when basis z-score (trailing, as-of) exceeds a registered threshold: long spot/short perp (positive basis) or the reverse where spot shorting is available
execution_model: taker perp + taker spot; legs not atomic: leg risk modelled
exit: basis back inside a registered band or a time stop

funding_interval_handling.method: interval-normalised: funding_bps_per_day = rate_bps * 1440 / fundingInterval_min per symbol; holding-horizon funding = bps/day x days; per-interval cohorts (480m / 240m / 60m) reported separately; settlement grid is per symbol; a Closed contract earns nothing after its deliveryTime
funding_interval_handling.source_of_interval_facts: OWNER-OBSERVED live probe (unverified in this repo): Bybit funding interval is per symbol (480m, 240m, sometimes 60m) and 14 of the top 20 positive-funding perps over $5M turnover were 240m contracts
funding_interval_handling.unknown_interval: funding normalisation UNKNOWN -> the candidate cannot pass

hypothesis: The perp-minus-spot basis mean-reverts after dislocations beyond costs.

prospective_protocol.description: register thresholds then observe forward basis excursions and fills on testnet mechanics
prospective_protocol.note: floors only: no start date is claimed here; the registration that opens the window sets and seals it

rejection_conditions: no synchronised spot/perp data of at least 1-minute resolution exists for the test window
net edge after assumed costs not positive
profit concentrated in fewer than 5 independent excursions
basis widens beyond the stop in more than a registered share of entries

required_data.gap: spot BTC 1h/4h OHLCV and Bybit linear 1d exist; not synchronised tick or 1m
required_data.name: synchronised spot and perp mid/mark prices at settlement and intra-8h

required_data.gap: BTC/ETH spot L2 only; no perp book history
required_data.name: spot and perp L2 depth

risk_model: basis widens before it converges; perp margin calls on the short leg; spot custody
status_note: SPECIFICATION ONLY. Nothing has been tested; this is not a winner. A bias_declaration is True only where the data needed to rule that bias out is in the repo; it is False wherever a required_data item with repo_has=false names it in declaration_keys.
